A '''Sparkling Podium''' is an {{Epic}} Cosmetic that shows the player's [[Sparkling Critterdex]] progress.

== Obtaining ==
A '''Sparkling Podium''' can be obtained after capturing {{Green|10}} unique [[Sparkling Critter]]s in the [[Sparkling Critterdex]].

== Usage ==
Placing a '''Sparkling Podium''' displays the player's progress in the [[Sparkling Critterdex]]. Right-clicking on the podium opens a UI that allows the player to choose a [[Sparkling Critter]] they have caught to display.
